title: FileContentInfo
description: One file's content on one side of the comparison. A deleted file has no working-tree side and an added file has no HEAD side, so absent is an ordinary answer rather than an error.

kind.description: text when the content is present; binary when it is not decodable text; absent when the file does not exist on that side; too_large when it exceeds the size the host will send.

text.description: Decoded content. Present only when kind is text.

sizeBytes.description: Size in bytes on the requested side, zero when the file is absent. Always the true size, even when the content was withheld for being too large.

encoding.description: Name of the encoding the bytes were decoded with. Reported rather than assumed, so the interface can say what it did instead of showing replacement characters as if they were the file.

usedFallbackEncoding.description: True when the bytes were not valid UTF-8 and a fallback encoding was used. The text is readable, but it is a best effort and the interface should admit that.
